88:t_020:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「The touching reunion can wait! First, we'll take down $$バルビエル$$!」

88:t_020:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's this, Uncle $$ランド$$? You're awfully serious!」

88:t_020:14.en:
$$恵子$$
「And $$ガンレオン$$ is in Magna Mode from the start...」

88:t_020:15.en:
$$メール$$
「That's because my darling's burning anger is setting $$ガンレオン$$ ablaze.」

88:t_020:16.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Could it be the power of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$'s $$スフィア$$?」

88:t_020:18.en:
$$ランド$$
「And I'll tell you this: that $$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ power is greater than mine or $$セツコ$$'s.」

88:t_020:20.en:
$n
「The $$傷だらけの獅子$$ and the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...」

88:t_021:1.en:
$n
「I'm all right! Thanks for the repairs!」

88:t_021:4.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain! We have a transmission from the resistance!」

88:t_021:5.en:
$$ラム$$
「They've broken through the nearby interceptors and will reach this area in three minutes!」

88:t_021:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, you heard that! The resistance will be here in three minutes!」

88:t_021:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Be very careful of the enemy $$スフィア・リアクター$$! He's creating a special field around himself!」

88:t_021:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's that thing called a $$スフィア・アクト$$...!」

88:t_021:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Apparently, its effects differ for each $$リアクター$$!」

88:t_021:10.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Hold out for three minutes, and we'll have the numbers advantage, too! Hang in there until then!」

88:t_021:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I can't stand any of you...」

88:t_021:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「The feeling's mutual. I haven't forgotten what you did.」

88:t_021:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You second-rate $$リアクター$$...! I'll teach you your place!」

88:t_021:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'll fight people like you, who've trampled on others' lives!」

88:t_021:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「Get ready, $$バルビエル$$! I've finally caught you...! It's payback time!!」

88:t_022:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Is that all you've got?」

88:t_022:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Someone with the $$烙印$$ and a second-rate $$リアクター$$... Such a waste of power.」

88:t_022:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You bastard!!」

88:t_022:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$傷だらけの獅子$$... You can roar all you like, but you can't defeat me.」

88:t_023:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Three minutes have passed. It's about time.」

88:t_023:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Someone with the $$烙印$$ and a second-rate $$リアクター$$... Such a waste of power.」

88:t_023:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You bastard!!」

88:t_023:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$傷だらけの獅子$$... You can roar all you like, but you can't defeat me.」

88:t_024:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...You want this base that badly?」

88:t_024:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then you can have it.」

88:t_025:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Has realizing he's lost driven him crazy!?」

88:t_025:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「We don't need this base anymore. This Earth has its limits after all...」

88:t_025:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You understand what I mean, don't you, Turn-type?」

88:t_025:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He's... looking at the $$ホワイトドール$$...!?」

88:t_026:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Lord $$バルビエル$$, preparations are complete.」

88:t_026:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's been a while, $$ランド$$. Unfortunately, we don't even have time for tea.」

88:t_026:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We have to head to $$蒼の地球$$ now.」

88:t_026:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I told you. This Earth has its limits.」

88:t_026:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This planet's land was eaten away by poison in the past.」

88:t_026:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Shall we go, Lord $$バルビエル$$? ...Though there are obstacles in our path.」

88:t_027:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're an eyesore, small fry...!」

88:t_028:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's go, $$サルディアス$$.」

88:t_029:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What happened to the resistance?」

88:t_029:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「B-But...! At least we've accomplished the mission!」

88:t_029:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Can we... call this a victory...?」

88:t_029:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

88:t_029:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「He said he was going to $$蒼の地球$$.」

88:t_029:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then we're going, too! We'll pay him back on the other Earth!」

88:t_029:9.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He... seemed to know something... about the $$ホワイトドール$$...」

88:t_029:10.en:
$$メール$$
「Don't let it bother you, $$ロラン$$. He enjoys getting under people's skin like that.」

88:t_029:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Do you and the others know him, $$ランド$$?」

88:t_029:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah... We've got one hell of a score to settle with that bastard.」
